title: Sub-Gaussian Confidence Intervals for Heavy-Tailed Data: Characterizing the Limits of Inference
summary: We investigate the problem of uncertainty quantification in the mean estimation framework. Given an i.i.d. sample from a distribution with unknown mean $μ$ and variance $σ^2$, we want to construct an estimator $\whμ_n$ and provide a computable and size-optimal upper bound for the error $|\wh μ_n - μ|$. While estimators possessing strong deviation guarantees are well known, no data-dependent non-asymptotic upper bounds for their performance exist in general.
